summary: The user-approved TS active-learning logic is implemented as a geometry-gated, committee-preferred workflow with failure-boundary pairing, clustered information sampling, VASP magnetic/force quality gates, four-quadrant routing, and automatic local preparation. The current 18-structure fallback batch is deployed but unsubmitted.

payload.objective: Execute the geometry-qualified MatRIS TS active-learning workflow automatically for the Fe(110) C2HO* + H* -> C2H2O* path, using a real MatRIS committee when available and the explicit MatRIS/AQCat25/VASP-error fallback otherwise.
current_evidence: Job 1324 supplies one geometry-valid 17-image last-good snapshot and a geometry-valid first failure boundary at image 12; `pre_12` and `fail_12` are preserved as distinct hash-bound samples.

The scientific trigger excludes runtime failures and geometry-invalid paths. Atom mapping, periodic unwrap, endpoint/cell/fixed-mask compatibility, minimum pair distance, and adjacent continuity must pass before any structure can enter training consideration.

The preferred uncertainty source is a committee of three to five independently trained, production-accepted checkpoints of one MatRIS architecture. AQCat25 is an optional exact-structure external auditor and never a MatRIS committee member.

The current inventory has fewer than three accepted MatRIS checkpoints. This round therefore uses MatRIS primary plus AQCat25 audit and later actual VASP error; it cannot report uncertainty or use four-quadrant committee calibration yet.

Sampling now preserves last-valid/first-failure points and ranks available committee disagreement, external-auditor disagreement, descriptor novelty, TS proximity, failure proximity, and reaction-coordinate backtracking. Raw units are converted to within-batch percentile ranks and at most seven structures are clustered/deduplicated. Peak neighbors are not universally mandatory.

VASP labels are compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV NSW=0 statics with LORBIT=11. Normal/electronic completion, complete all-atom forces, total magnetization, atom-resolved magnetic moments, and exact structure/compatibility hashes are required before training.
A real committee enables disagreement-versus-actual-error four-quadrant routing. Without it, the workflow decides from model-specific VASP error and available novelty and makes no uncertainty claim.

The new 18-structure request SHA-256 is f01b10a39c5af586bb8db7d43643313527039d48afbf0fabe61421a11fe02fdb. It and the updated runtime are deployed and preflighted on MZ73. No GPU, VASP, fine-tuning, rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer job has been submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: After explicit authorization, submit exactly one bounded MZ73 job for the deployed 18-structure MatRIS/AQCat25 fallback prediction batch. On completion, automatically collect the exact predictions, score/cluster/select at most seven structures including the `pre_12`/`fail_12` boundary pair, and prepare but do not submit the compatible VASP label batch.
payload.submission_boundary: Local geometry classification, snapshot preservation, request preparation, scoring, clustering, result assessment, and next-stage package preparation may run automatically. Remote GPU prediction, VASP labels, MatRIS fine-tuning, full-path rerun, VASP micro-NEB, and Dimer submission each require the applicable reviewed hash-bound authority; direct GPU-to-VASP submission remains forbidden.
done_when: Exact MatRIS and AQCat25 predictions exist for all 18 frozen round-0 structures, including the last-valid/first-failure boundary pair.
At most seven clustered informative structures have accepted VASP energy, complete all-atom forces, and total/atom-resolved magnetic evidence on the active compatibility branch.
MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors are assessed separately, and committee-error quadrants are added only if a valid three-to-five-member MatRIS committee exists.
If MatRIS fails, replay-buffer energy/force-aware fine-tuning yields a new versioned checkpoint, the complete path is rerun, and force-tail/relative-energy retention gates pass.

A disjoint rising/near-saddle/falling VASP held-out set passes before active-learning acceleration is called calibrated, after which the least-cost VASP micro-NEB or Dimer route enters the authoritative TS gates.
